body.statement: For arbitrary ordered absorbing support \(\mathcal S\) and positive law \(\Pi\), enumerate the connected sign chambers of the admissible adjacent-ratio floor domain cut out by every Cramer-determinant zero set, give the chamberwise signs and boundary incidences of all \(L_{j,t,\ell}(\Pi)\), and structurally characterize the simultaneous off-diagonal-zero locus, including repeated shifted boundary coordinates and every nonsingular support-rank stratum.
body.justification: The pointwise Cramer certificate computes signs at a supplied law but does not give the global chamber decomposition and boundary incidence structure.
body.gap: No cited source globally enumerates the semialgebraic sign chambers of reshaped finite-memory carryover loadings over the admissible adjacent-ratio domain.
body.consumer: The global classification would tell an analyst which loading-sign regimes and exact off-diagonal-zero designs are reachable before selecting a reshaping law.

obligation.what_is_open: A finite structural enumeration of every connected determinant-sign chamber, its boundary incidences, and the simultaneous off-diagonal-zero locus over all admissible adjacent ratios.
obligation.obstruction: The proved Cramer formulas decide a single supplied ratio vector but do not control the global arrangement of determinant zero sets on the ratio-floor domain.
obligation.attempted: The project derived the ordered interval matrices, the support-rank graph criterion, and exact positive-denominator determinant formulas for every individual loading coordinate.
obligation.partial_result: For every supplied positive law, exact rational arithmetic terminates and certifies every loading sign and zero; only the global chamber enumeration remains open.
